{{Top|leg}}
'''Ossi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was used as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|427|Ossi}}</ref>

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Ossi was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
